verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a large community-built SDK ecosystem alongside the official SDKs, and sentry-cli can send events without an app-level SDK. Users also say the fully open-source code let them see exactly how integrations work, which implies a reverse-engineerable protocol. However, no item actually documents the event-ingestion protocol or envelope format for custom-client authors. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the ingestion protocol and payload schema, explicit guidance for building compatible SDKs, and hands-on reports of custom clients sending events.
